title: Manchester City extends Khusanov through 2031 after breakthrough season
dek: Manchester City signed 22-year-old defender Abdukodir Khusanov to a new contract running through 2031 with an option for an additional year, replacing his previous deal set to expire in 2029. Khusanov made 37 appearances in all competitions last season and started in both the Carabao Cup and FA Cup finals.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Abdukodir Khusanov signed a new five-year contract with Manchester City through 2031, plus one optional year, extending from his previous 2029 expiration.
bottom_line: Manchester City lock in promising Uzbek defender Abdukodir Khusanov on extended five-year contract through 2031.
body: Manchester City signed 22-year-old defender Abdukodir Khusanov to a new contract through 2031, with an option for an additional year, according to ESPN. The deal replaces his existing contract, which was set to expire in 2029.

Khusanov arrived at Manchester City from French club Lens in January 2025. In his first season with the club, he made 37 appearances across all competitions and started in both the Carabao Cup final and the FA Cup final, per ESPN's reporting. He was also part of Uzbekistan's World Cup squad.

Hugo Viana, Manchester City's director of football, stated the club has been impressed by Khusanov's development. "We've been really pleased and impressed by Abdukodir's development since he arrived in England," Viana said, according to ESPN. "We're seeing him grow into a brilliant young man and an outstanding defender, but we know this is only the beginning. His physical and technical abilities are top, he has all the assets needed to be a world-class centre-back."

Khusanov said he is motivated to earn a regular role under new manager Enzo Maresca. "I am really happy to extend my stay at City. I've enjoyed every minute since I arrived in Manchester and I feel I am growing and learning a lot as a player," Khusanov said, per ESPN. "I have a new challenge now, which is to impress Enzo Maresca and his staff and ensure I am in his team regularly. I am determined to do that."
The financial terms of the extension are not disclosed in available sources.

The Bottom Line: Khusanov's extended contract reflects Manchester City's confidence in his trajectory after a season that included appearances in two cup finals. Watch whether he secures regular starts under Maresca and whether the investment in the young defender translates to sustained playing time as the club's competitive window evolves.
